baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse first inhibits reactive speech, then redirects the mouth from incoming utterance into purification joined to the opposite of blame; naming the Lord adds an ongoing repair-and-formation relation.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self from panic supplies the response's inhibitory stage.
Emitted utterance supplies the verbal pressure entering the mechanism.
Purification and exoneration supply the redirected speech act.
Praise as the contrary of blame reverses the hostile verbal register.
Repair, nurture, and completion make praise formative rather than merely defensive.

changed_reading.before: Endure what they say, then praise God at appointed times.
changed_reading.after: Contain the impulse produced by their utterance and make one's own mouth generate purifying, reparative praise instead of reproducing blame.

baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated precedence places praise on the approach side of both solar appearance and disappearance. The practice therefore pre-orients the reader before change arrives rather than merely marking a clock time after the fact.

activation_trace.role: Advance and approach give both repeated temporal markers an anticipatory direction.
The luminary's rising supplies the threshold of appearance.
The sun supplies the visible daily body that crosses the first threshold.
Sunset supplies the opposed threshold of disappearance.

changed_reading.before: The verse names two devotional time slots.
changed_reading.after: The verse installs praise just before opposite transitions, training agency to meet appearance and withdrawal already oriented.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early uttered objection calls return distant; palm growth then uses the focus root for an emerging spadix, and revived land is explicitly likened to emergence. Solar rising in the focus can thus function as a recurrent, enacted counter-image to the speech being endured.

activation_trace.role: The focus anchors the model in the utterance that patience must meet.
Solar rising supplies a daily visible emergence in the focus.
The opponents' emitted saying introduces the objection later gathered by 'what they say.'
Return to a prior state supplies the proposition dismissed as distant.
Plant emergence gives the focus root a generative, organic occurrence inside the context.
Passage outward names the emergence for which revived land is the context's model.

structural_cues: 50:2-3 voices the return objection; 50:10-11 answers with growth and emergence before the focus repeats the rising root.
The focus answers saying with a timed act rather than another proposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the objection, the shared ط ل ع root, revived land, and خروج; I infer that recurrent sunrise-praise performs a counter-image to denied return. A live alternative is that the two times are only a schedule with no symbolic argumentative role.

changed_reading.after: Patience declines a verbal quarrel with denial of return and instead rehearses emergence through praise before each recurrent rising.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context lays out a speech chain from hidden self-talk to words cast from the mouth and held under present watch. The focus command interrupts that chain before the addressee's response becomes another blame-bearing utterance, routing it into praise instead.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies the interruption between stimulus and response.
Purifying speech supplies the accountable replacement output.
Hidden self-talk supplies the inward beginning of the speech chain.
Producing speech with the tongue supplies the chain's outward transition.
Utterance connects the monitored context directly to the focus wording.
Watching and waiting make emitted speech consequential rather than disposable.
Present readiness makes the monitoring immediate at the moment of speech.

structural_cues: 50:16 moves from inward whisper to 50:18 outward utterance; 50:39 pairs others' saying with the addressee's commanded vocal act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the inner-to-outer speech sequence and ready observation; I infer a reflexive arrow from enduring their words to governing one's own next word. Alternatively, the monitoring scene may concern accountability generally without specifying the mechanism of patience.

changed_reading.before: The addressee passively withstands other people's speech.
changed_reading.after: The addressee actively governs the full inward-to-outward production of a consequential response, choosing praise as the utterance to release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised recipient is both a recurrent returner and a keeper, then comes with a returning heart. Repeated praise at the sun's two boundaries becomes a formation practice: each daily departure and return trains habitual reorientation rather than merely filling two appointments.

activation_trace.role: Sunset supplies the focus's daily departure threshold.
Repeated precedence supplies the recurring practice before both thresholds.
Return to a place supplies the recipient's recurrent orientation.
The sun's setting toward its return point directly couples return with the focus's sunset boundary.
Constancy and maintenance turn return into a kept habit.
Habitual recurrence supplies the returning quality of the heart.

structural_cues: 50:32-33 repeats two return formations immediately before the focus's repeated daily thresholds.
The ء و ب inventory itself contains sunset as a return image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies returner, keeper, returning heart, and the sunset-return branch; I infer that repeated threshold praise cultivates that disposition. A live alternative is that these are recipient labels independent of the practice commanded in 50:39.

changed_reading.before: Praise is performed twice daily because those are assigned times.
changed_reading.after: Repeated threshold praise trains the heart to return, preserve its orientation, and return again as reliably as the daily setting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding creation statement negates even the touch of fatigue, then the focus opens with a consequential 'so be patient.' Patience is reframed from emergency tolerance as sustained participation in an ordered work, while praise marks the finite human rhythm that renews it.

activation_trace.role: Holding steady supplies the human practice drawn from the adjacent frame.
Nurture and completion prevent steadiness from becoming mere depletion.
Bringing creation into being supplies the sustained work preceding the command.
Incidence of an effect supplies the explicitly negated contact with fatigue.
Weakness and weariness supply what the creation statement denies.

structural_cues: 50:38 immediately precedes the focus, whose first word begins with فَـ.
Creation spans a measured duration; focus praise is also distributed across measured daily transitions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, the opening فَـ, creation, and negated fatigue; I infer a directional analogy from unwearied ordered work to sustained human patience, with praise as finite renewal. The alternative is simple sequencing with no imitation or grounding relation.

changed_reading.before: Patience is a temporary defensive reaction to hurtful speech.
changed_reading.after: Patience is sustained work inside an ordered rhythm, renewed by praise rather than imagined as human immunity to fatigue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's two 'before' edges are followed by night praise and the aftermath of prostration. Leading and trailing positions now surround both the day and a ritual act, making praise a recursive enclosure of time rather than two isolated observances.

activation_trace.role: Repeated advance supplies the two leading edges of the enclosure.
Night as the contrary of day extends praise beyond both solar thresholds.
Worship by praise repeats the focus action inside the night segment.
The end and aftermath supply a trailing edge after ritual action.
Bending in prostration supplies the bounded ritual whose aftermath is also marked.

structural_cues: 50:39 repeats 'before'; 50:40 adds 'from the night' and 'after prostration.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies leading, nocturnal, and trailing positions; I infer that their arrangement encloses daily and ritual time. They may alternatively be three independent prescriptions without a designed enclosure mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse prescribes praise at dawn and sunset.
changed_reading.after: Praise wraps around change, darkness, and the completion of prostration, repeatedly reclaiming both the approach to an event and what follows it.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus turns away from present human saying, the context commands listening to a near call, then depicts a true cry, emergence, opening earth, and gathered movement. Praise before ordinary rising becomes sensory preparation for a radically different call and emergence that cannot be managed once it arrives.

activation_trace.role: Present emitted speech supplies the sound field from which attention must be disengaged.
Visible appearance supplies the focus's ordinary daily emergence.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the commanded receptive posture.
Raised calling supplies the near summons for which listening is required.
The alarming cry supplies the decisive sound opposed to current human talk.
Passage outward supplies the named day of emergence.
Earth opening supplies the material channel of that emergence.
Driving and gathering toward one destination supplies the emergence's collective direction.

structural_cues: 50:39 moves from what they say to praise; 50:41 explicitly commands listening; 50:42-44 unfolds call, emergence, opened earth, and gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the auditory reversal and emergence sequence; I infer that praise before sunrise trains attention before the true call and final emergence. The alternative is that sunrise only dates worship and bears no rehearsal relation to 50:41-44.

changed_reading.before: The addressee ignores hostile speech and observes a morning time.
changed_reading.after: The addressee exchanges fixation on present talk for disciplined praise and listening, using each ordinary rising as preparation for the true call and collective emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing verse repeats 'what they say,' assigns full knowledge of it elsewhere, explicitly removes coercive control from the addressee, and substitutes Qur'anic reminder. Patience therefore becomes a public method with a firm boundary: sustain truthful address without forcing reception.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies the capacity to remain within the noncoercive boundary.
The focus wording anchors the later closure's exact return to their utterance.
Full cognitive disclosure assigns knowledge of their saying beyond the addressee.
The repeated emitted saying closes the loop opened in the focus.
Coercive force supplies the mode explicitly denied to the addressee.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies the permitted response mode.
Recitation supplies the medium of noncoercive reminder.
Anticipatory fear identifies responsive hearers without authorizing force over others.

structural_cues: 50:45 repeats بِمَا يَقُولُونَ from the focus nearly verbatim, then coordinates negated compulsion with an imperative to remind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact speech echo, divine knowledge, negated coercion, and commanded reminder; I infer that these clauses specify the operational content of patience. A weaker alternative is that 50:45 independently summarizes the mission without revising 50:39's patience.

changed_reading.before: Patience is private emotional endurance while opponents continue speaking.
changed_reading.after: Patience is the noncoercive discipline of leaving their speech fully known to God while continuing praise and reminder without trying to force assent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus branch of صبر as severity with no exit through 50:36's failed route-search. It remains anchored in the imperative and in actual context roots for probing and evasion; downstream prose should present it as a spatial analogy, not claim that صبر lexically means entrapment here.

activation_trace.role: Severity with no outlet supplies the focus's exploratory spatial image.
Travel and probing through lands supply an exhaustive search for routes.
Deviation away from a direction supplies the escape that the context questions.

changed_reading.before: Patience waits for pressure to pass or for an exit to appear.
changed_reading.after: Patience can be imagined as remaining rightly oriented after evasive routes have been exhausted, without treating escape as the condition for fidelity.

strongest_changes: The exact echo in 50:45 turns patience into a noncoercive public method: their speech is known, while the addressee reminds rather than compels.
Plant emergence, revived land, the true call, and opened earth make praise before sunrise a recurrent rehearsal of emergence rather than a bare clock marker.
Returner, keeper, returning heart, and the extended night-and-after sequence turn two thresholds into a durable habit that encloses daily and ritual time.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made the focus roots migrate across domains without losing their anchors: ط ل ع moves from palm growth to solar rise, ء و ب supplies sunset as return, and ق و ل moves from denied return through monitored utterance to explicitly noncoercive reminder.
remaining_uncertainties: The emergence and return models may be deliberate symbolic mechanisms or only resonances around literal worship times.
The no-fatigue adjacency supports sustained patience, but equating finite human endurance with divine unweariedness would exceed the packet.
The no-exit model is branch-distant and should remain an exploratory spatial analogy.
